text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide, large enemy at 10 o'clock!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A frontal assault works against our odds. There should be a narrow corridor back where we came from.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Then I'll lure it in and pin it down. Hayahide, get ready for a pincer attack—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to spectate a horse girl shooter tournament held on the VR Umalator, but...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Team Taishin & Hayahide! They've slain the giant creature and secured the points!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Talk about true same-generation synergy, huh? Supporting each other in complete sync~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Their team play was super tactical and awesome to watch! Isn't that a ton of pressure for the next team?

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Next up to the challenge is Team Kris S & Gimlet!! Can they catch up to Taishin & Hayahide~~?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Now... lay your finger on the trigger! Let us go greet the goddess of victory!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
——Got it.
Executing——the mission.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: A team of the 'Sergeant' and the 'God of Destruction'~...? Isn't that combo way too mismatched?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san will... well, she'll probably execute her duties flawlessly, but...

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Gimlet-san is totally chaotic, right...? Won't she just drag her around and throw off their entire pace?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Feast upon this! The silver bullet that annihilates all creation!! Haaah-hah-hah-hah!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet——...slow down a bit.
——Slowly...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet charges recklessly forward. Following behind, Symboli Kris S seems to be dragged along by her pace, but...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: A massive horde of creatures has appeared!! They swarm the forward-charging Gimlet!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Scatter all obstacles and carve open the path! That is the very reason for a God of Destruction's existence!!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Gimlet is blasting, blasting right through them~~!! But taking advantage of an opening, the enemy mounts a flank ambush—!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——...Not happening.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BANG!! BANG!! BANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: What an intervention! Kris S provides covering fire!! Sniping down enemy after enemy bearing down on Gimlet from behind~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuh-kuh-kuh...! What exquisite gunfire caressing my ears!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Then I shall play my part in this melody!! Perish, embraced by this requiem!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I'll cover you——
Advance without looking back——forward.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Reckless aggression backed by pinpoint covering fire... To think that would break into the top of the rankings.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Kuh-kuh-kuh! Now that I have gained wings of steel, no barrier exists that I cannot shatter...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That covering fire barely grazing past her was insane. Weren't you scared of friendly fire or something?
choice_data_list: If it were me, I might've hesitated out of fear of hitting an ally.
If it were me, I might've hesitated out of fear of hitting an ally.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ——...There was——no fear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I... understood.
How Gimlet... would move.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is... simply all.
choice_data_list: Is there a trick to understanding him?
Is there a trick to understanding him?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: That is... simply all.
choice_data_list: Is there a trick to understanding him?
Is there a trick to understanding him?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh!
You predict my movements, my worthy rival?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall shatter the 'me' inside your mind as well!
For one must charge forward far beyond all predictions!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...No.
I will... seize you. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: A trick... ...hmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Gimlet's words are... esoteric.
Therefore――Don't think about it.
choice_data_list: Don't think, feel... Is that it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...No, that's way too hard.
